t: A touch-pad synth kit that becomes a new instrument with each firmware swap.
steps: Buy the assembled Touch 2 or the kit from the Synthux Academy store.
Build the kit with the Touch 2 build tutorial, or skip this step for the assembled unit.
Plug in headphones or a speaker and play the loaded instrument.
Download a different instrument from the simple-touch-instruments repo.
Upload it over USB and swap in the matching faceplate.
Install the Arduino IDE with DaisyDuino to edit an instrument.
Watch the Academy video lessons to write your own sounds.
meta: Open Code. From $299. A few stores.
